name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native selective routing with evidence-led convergence and candidate-bound review.

interface.shortDescription: Declare a risk-gated route and use at most one auxiliary by default.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps architecture, verification, and acceptance with the root. Before work begins, it declares a SELECTIVE ROUTE and one shared acceptance basis. Solo is the default; delegate uses one implementer; audit adds candidate-bound fresh review; full combines both only for a broad or high-risk exception. Findings are closed by cause and evidence instead of repeated local patching. Spawned auxiliary evidence is fail-closed.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Use solo by default; select delegate, audit, or exceptional full only when the stated risk justifies it.
